Specification: This module specifies the classic prisoners-and-switches puzzle in which one designated prisoner acts as a counter and all other prisoners use one switch to signal visits. The state consists of two boolean switches, a function tracking how many times each non-counter prisoner has moved switch A up, and a count of how many times the counter has moved switch A down. The specification includes an initial condition, next-state actions for the counter and non-counter prisoners, weak fairness assumptions ensuring every prisoner is brought into the room infinitely often, and temporal properties asserting both safety and eventual completion.
IfThenElse: IF (~switchAUp) /\ (timesSwitched[i] < 2) THEN /\ switchAUp' = TRUE /\ timesSwitched' = [timesSwitched EXCEPT ![i] = @+1] /\ UNCHANGED switchBUp ELSE /\ switchBUp' = ~switchBUp /\ UNCHANGED <<switchAUp, timesSwitched>>
IF switchAUp THEN /\ switchAUp' = FALSE /\ UNCHANGED switchBUp /\ count' =  count + 1 ELSE /\ switchBUp' = ~switchBUp /\ UNCHANGED <<switchAUp, count>>
IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET p == CHOOSE pr \in S : TRUE IN  timesSwitched[p] + sum[S \ {p}]

DivisionNotes: Partition count: StatePredicate(5) + TemporalProperty(4) + Init(1) + ValueDef(3) + ActionDefNames(3) = OperatorDefNames(16). Verified.

Fairness is classified as a StatePredicate by the requested rule because its body contains no explicit primed variables and no temporal operators [], <>, or ~>; it contains only fairness operators WF_vars(...), which are temporal in meaning but are not among the operators designated for TemporalProperty in this division.
PostCondition is included in StatePredicate by elimination: it is Boolean-valued and has an empty body in the source.
CounterExample is included in ValueDef by elimination: it defines a non-Boolean record value rather than a predicate, action, or temporal property.

TemporalNesting is false. No temporal operator appears explicitly nested inside another temporal operator in the file text. In particular, CountInfOftenZero uses []<> as adjacent temporal operators rather than one explicit temporal expression syntactically inside another line such as [](... <> ...).
CorpusSource used module-name folder because the repository subfolder could not be determined from file content.
